name: Forms.md Free Branded Forms
free_limit: Free forever: all form features, unlimited form responses, and one end product for personal or client use, with Forms.md branding. Open-source form renderer can be installed with npm or browser assets.
watch_out: Free plan retains Forms.md branding and excludes email/chat support; removing branding requires a one-time paid license. The published free-plan terms specify one end product; check licensing scope before deploying multiple branded products. You supply a submission endpoint and any hosting, storage or email services. Do not confuse the Apache-2.0 library with a free hosted form-response backend.
